content_zh: 修复开发者后台不显示自己的游戏，并消除作者页轻微卡顿。① 后台「暂无绑定您的游戏 / 未认证」根因：dashboard.html 从未引入 common.js，而它调用的 window.fetchAuthors() 只定义在 common.js，异常被 catch 静默吞掉导致 myGames 恒为空。现把作者清单统一定义到 head 同步加载的 boot.js（无 UI 副作用，dashboard 无需新增 script 标签），common.js 改为守卫式定义以兼容 game/ 子页面直连；dashboard 另加本地清单兜底、8s 请求超时，并把空态/侧栏/创作者卡文案区分为「档案读取失败」「未关联档案」「已关联但 0 游戏」三种情况，不再一律要求重新认证。② 修掉 4.0.12 批量替换误伤 common.js / index.js 中 leleleOnReady 函数体造成的无限递归（同步加载 common.js 的 authorlevel.html / apply-certification.html 会栈溢出，是偶发卡顿来源）。③ 作者页首屏提速：同域 authors/index.json 即时渲染名字/等级/徽标，surge 权威数据随后无感校正；Supabase 资料保存为 override，清单校正时不会被覆盖，并按 uuid 去重避免重复查询。④ sw.js 加注释并升 v1.4 触发重新 install 清理 v1.3 旧缓存（策略不变），首页新手引导与 notice.js 对齐 onReady。实测：模拟登录态打开后台显示 12 款游戏、开发者 ID 1、等级 6 与官方徽标；阻断 surge/analytics 后仍显示 12 款；authorlevel/apply-certification 0 个栈溢出错误；作者页名字与 12 款游戏即时可见；lint 0 错误。
content_en: Fixed the developer dashboard not showing the creator's own games and removed the remaining author-page lag. (1) The dashboard never loaded common.js, yet called window.fetchAuthors() which was only defined there; the swallowed TypeError left myGames empty, producing 'No games found' and 'Not certified'. fetchAuthors is now defined once in boot.js (loaded synchronously in <head> on 14 pages, no UI side effects), common.js keeps a guarded fallback for game/ subpages that load it directly, and the dashboard adds a local-index fallback, 8s fetch timeouts, and three distinct empty states (profile load failed / account not linked / linked but zero games). (2) Fixed an infinite recursion accidentally introduced into leleleOnReady in common.js/index.js in 4.0.12, which caused stack overflow on pages that load common.js synchronously (authorlevel.html, apply-certification.html). (3) Author page first paint: same-origin authors/index.json renders name/level/badges instantly while surge asynchronously reconciles; Supabase profile fields are stored as an override so reconciliation cannot clobber them, and queries are de-duplicated by uuid. (4) sw.js bumped to v1.4 (comment + cache name only, strategy unchanged) to purge stale v1.3 caches; homepage onboarding and notice.js now use onReady. Verified with a mocked logged-in session: dashboard shows 12 games, Dev ID 1, level 6 and official badge; still 12 games with surge/analytics blocked; zero stack-overflow errors; author page shows name and 12 games immediately; 0 lint errors.

content_zh: 全站访问速度根治（国内外都能快速打开）。根因：4.0.11 把 jsdelivr 的 supabase-js 改为 defer 后，defer 脚本必须在 DOMContentLoaded 之前全部下载执行完，而全站初始化（含首页游戏列表）都挂在 DOMContentLoaded / load 上；jsdelivr、analytics 等外部域在国内挂起时（浏览器对 script 请求没有默认超时），这两个事件永不触发，导致一直加载、白屏、刷新无响应、头像与内容全出不来。修复：① supabase-js / pinyin-pro / echarts 三个库自托管到同域 /vendor/，彻底移除 jsdelivr 依赖；analytics 统计脚本改由 boot.js 在首屏之后动态异步注入，失败静默。② 全站初始化改用 onReady（readyState 非 loading 立即执行），不再死等 DOMContentLoaded / load；修 dashboard/login 的 supabase-client.js 与 SDK 执行顺序不一致的旧 bug，并给 dashboard 裸 client 调用加守卫。③ sw.js 按用户要求加注释改变文件字节、CACHE_NAME 升 v1.3 触发浏览器重新 install 并清理 v1.0~v1.2 旧缓存；策略由纯 network-first 改为静态资源 stale-while-revalidate（命中缓存秒开、后台更新）+ 数据 JSON network-first 带 1.5s 超时快速回退；移除升版时自动 location.reload() 避免反复刷新。④ 恢复十月底以来稳定的作者数据主源 https://authors.surge.sh/authors.json（已核实 access-control-allow-origin:*，跨域无问题），带 5s 超时，本地 authors/index.json 仅作离线兜底。实测：阻断全部外部域名后，首页仍渲染 26 个游戏卡片、作者页渲染作者卡与游戏列表，各页 0 个 JS 运行时错误。
content_en: Site-wide speed fix (fast both in and outside China). Root cause: 4.0.11 deferred the jsdelivr supabase-js script; defer scripts must finish downloading/executing before DOMContentLoaded, and every page init (including the homepage game list) was bound to DOMContentLoaded/load. When jsdelivr/analytics stalled in CN (browsers have no default script timeout), those events never fired -> endless loading, blank page, unresponsive refresh, missing avatars and content. Fixes: (1) Self-host supabase-js / pinyin-pro / echarts under same-origin /vendor/, removing all jsdelivr deps; analytics is now injected asynchronously after first paint via boot.js and fails silently. (2) All init now uses onReady (runs immediately when readyState is not loading) instead of waiting on DOMContentLoaded/load; fixed the dashboard/login bug where supabase-client.js ran before the deferred SDK, and added null guards for bare client calls. (3) sw.js gets a version comment (byte change) + CACHE_NAME v1.3 to force re-install and purge v1.0-v1.2 caches; strategy changed from pure network-first to stale-while-revalidate for static assets (instant cache hit, background update) and network-first with a 1.5s timeout fallback for data JSON; removed the auto location.reload() on SW updates. (4) Restored the long-stable author source https://authors.surge.sh/authors.json (verified access-control-allow-origin:*) with a 5s timeout; local authors/index.json is offline fallback only. Verified: with all external domains blocked, the homepage still renders 26 game cards and the author page renders its card + games, with zero JS runtime errors on all pages.

content_zh: 修复公开页（尤其作者页）上线白屏/卡顿：根因是 <head> 同步加载 supabase-js（jsdelivr 国内不稳）阻塞 HTML 解析，现 6 处脚本全部改为 defer；所有数据 fetch 加 8s 超时并去掉 no-store。作者数据本地分文件：新增 authors/index.json（轻量清单：id/uuid/名字/等级/徽标，省略默认与空值，保留平台字段）+ authors/data/<id>.json（仅 games_count，由 lelegame_data.json 自动统计），删除旧 authors.json。作者可编辑资料（bio/role/display_name/头像）仍从 Supabase profiles 按 uuid 非阻塞拉取，与 dashboard 编辑同源——作者换头像或改简介/名字无需改任何文件，失败降级默认图 + “头像加载失败”提示。同步工作流改为从 surge 的 authors.json 拆分生成 index + data（games_count 自动统计）。
content_en: Fixed public pages (esp. author page) white-screen/slowness on deploy: root cause was the synchronous supabase-js script in <head> (jsdelivr unstable in CN) blocking HTML parsing — now deferred on all 6 pages; all data fetches get an 8s timeout and drop no-store. Author data is now local & split: authors/index.json (lightweight list: id/uuid/name/level/badges, defaults/empties omitted) + authors/data/<id>.json (games_count only, auto-counted from lelegame_data.json), old authors.json removed. Author-editable fields (bio/role/display_name/avatar) still load non-blocking from Supabase profiles by uuid, sharing the same source as the dashboard — authors changing avatar or bio/name needs no file edits; falls back to default avatar + 'avatar failed' on error. Sync workflow splits surge authors.json into index + data (games_count auto-counted).

content_zh: 统一作者数据读取为 fetchAuthors()：同域 authors.json 优先，外域 surge.sh 兜底并带 5 秒超时，绝不卡死；在 surge.sh 更新作者（新增作者或未部署快照时）也能生效。修正 dashboard 提示文案，移除泄露给普通用户的内部文件名 'authors.json'。
content_en: Unified author data loading via fetchAuthors(): same-origin authors.json first, surge.sh fallback with a 5s timeout (never hangs); updating authors on surge.sh now takes effect in new-author / missing-snapshot cases. Also fixed a dashboard message that leaked the internal filename 'authors.json' to end users.

content_zh: 将作者数据源 authors.json 从外部域名 authors.surge.sh 改为托管到本站同域（repo 新增 authors.json，6 处引用全部改为同域读取：author.html / game.html / dashboard.html / index.js / notice.js）。原因：外部域名从部分网络访问极慢/卡死，导致作者页整页挂起（Chrome 提示关闭标签页）。配合 4.0.8 的非阻塞 + 5s 超时，作者页不再依赖外部网络，加载飞快且无白屏。注意：authors.json 现为仓库快照，作者信息变更后需重新拉取并更新部署。
content_en: Moved the author data source authors.json from the external domain authors.surge.sh to same-origin hosting (added authors.json to the repo; switched all 6 references to same-origin: author.html / game.html / dashboard.html / index.js / notice.js). Reason: the external domain was extremely slow/unreachable from some networks, causing the author page to hang (Chrome prompted to close the tab). Combined with the non-blocking + 5s-timeout fix in 4.0.8, the author page no longer depends on the external network and loads fast without white-screen. Note: authors.json is now a repo snapshot — re-fetch and redeploy when author data changes.

content_zh: 修复作者主页（author.html）偶发“加载不出来”：原先整页渲染被远程 authors.surge.sh 的 fetch 阻塞，一旦该远程变慢/挂起就白屏。现改为本地游戏数据先渲染、远程作者信息非阻塞并以 5 秒超时获取，拿到后刷新名字/头像/徽标，远程不可达也不会白屏。
content_en: Fixed author.html occasionally failing to load: the whole-page render was previously blocked by the remote authors.surge.sh fetch, so a slow/unreachable remote caused a blank page. Now the local game data renders first, while the remote author info loads non-blocking with a 5s timeout and refreshes name/avatar/badges when available — the page can no longer white-screen due to the remote.

content_zh: 修复游戏详情页：当无独立详情文件、回退到主列表加载时，原先会把简介写死为占位文字并丢弃截图；现改为透传真实 description / screenshots / banner 等字段（仅缺省时用占位）。更新 ID 25 游戏《双人大富翁》全部信息。
content_en: Fixed game detail page fallback: when no per-game detail file exists and it falls back to the main list, the description was previously hardcoded to a placeholder and screenshots were dropped; now it passes through real description / screenshots / banner fields (placeholder only when missing). Updated game ID 25 (Two-player Monopoly) with all details.

content_zh: 特效扩展至全站（React Bits 风格纯 CSS）：common.css 通过 @import 统一加载 effects.css；游戏卡 / 排行榜卡 / 作者卡 / 公告卡 / 详情卡悬浮显示渐变描边；按钮（action-btn / btn-primary）加入鼠标跟随聚光（Spotlight）；标题（panel-title / section-title / game-title 等）改为流动渐变文字；官方 / 原创徽标增加脉冲辉光。
content_en: Site-wide React Bits-style effects (pure CSS): effects.css is now imported globally via common.css; cards (game / ranking / author / announcement / detail) show an animated gradient border on hover; buttons (action-btn / btn-primary) get a pointer-follow spotlight; titles (panel-title / section-title / game-title, etc.) use animated gradient text; official / studio badges pulse with glow.

content_zh:
1. 【Dashboard 创作者认证】新增「创作者认证」标签页：展示来自 authors.json 的开发者全部信息（名称、开发者 ID、UUID、等级、官方认证、本站原创、已发布游戏数）与全部认证徽标（等级 / 官方 / 本站原创），未认证时引导去申请。
2. 【开发者 ID 可见】左上角用户卡与「个人资料」区均显示当前账号的开发者 ID（取自 authors.json）。
3. 【About / Docs 入口】后台侧栏新增「关于本站」与「认证文档」按钮。
4. 【React Bits 风格特效】创作者卡片加入渐变描边 + 辉光、极光背景、光泽扫过、徽标悬浮等纯 CSS 特效（effects.css，可复用）。
5. 【设置精简】移除自定义排版与排版模版，板块大小仅保留「游戏方块」一项。
6. 【公告弹窗 3 天缓存】升级提醒弹窗仅在 3 天缓存过期或出现真正新公告时弹出。
7. 【灵动岛】缩短收缩过渡并加 will-change，减少下滑卡顿。
content_en:
1. [Dashboard Creator Profile] New 'Creator Certification' tab shows the author's full info from authors.json (name, developer ID, UUID, level, official, studio-special, published count) and all certification badges (level / official / studio); un-certified users get an apply prompt.
2. [Visible Dev ID] The top-left user card and the Profile tab now show the account's developer ID (from authors.json).
3. [About / Docs links] Dashboard sidebar gains 'About' and 'Docs' buttons.
4. [React Bits-style effects] The creator card uses gradient-border + glow, aurora, shine sweep and badge float (pure-CSS effects.css, reusable).
5. [Settings cleanup] Removed custom layout and layout templates; section size keeps only 'Game cards'.
6. [Announcement 3-day cache] The update modal now only appears when the 3-day cache expires or a genuinely new announcement exists.
7. [Dynamic Island] Shortened collapse transition and added will-change to reduce scroll jank.

content_zh:
1. 【徽标可点击】游戏详情页作者行与作者页头部的认证徽标现在可点击：等级徽章跳转 authorlevel.html?level=N 等级说明页，官方 / 特殊徽章跳转认证文档；并在等级说明页与作者页提供「🏅 申请官方认证」按钮（带等级参数跳转 apply-certification.html）。
2. 【认证等级说明页】新增 authorlevel.html?level=N，按等级展示扩充后的晋升要求与权益（中英双语），点击徽标可直接到达对应等级。
3. 【入口补全】关于页（致独立开发者）与作者页作者卡新增「申请官方认证」入口。
content_en:
1. [Clickable badges] The certification badges on game detail author rows and author page headers are now clickable: the level badge jumps to authorlevel.html?level=N, while official/special badges jump to the certification doc; an '🏅 Apply for Certification' button (with level param) is added on the level page and author page.
2. [Level doc page] Added authorlevel.html?level=N showing expanded promotion requirements and perks per level (bilingual); clicking a badge lands on the right level.
3. [Entry points] Added an 'Apply for Certification' entry on the About page (To Indie Developers) and the author page card.

content_zh:
1. 【官方认证申请表单】新增 apply-certification.html，内嵌 Tally 认证申请表单（中文 kblp0R / 英文 LD9gO1），按站点语言自动切换；开发者后台新增「🏅 申请官方认证」入口；AUTHOR_CERTIFICATION.md 补充申请流程与字段说明。
2. 【认证英文名对齐】开发者等级英文名与 Tally 表单对齐：优质制作人 → Premium Producer，开发团队 → Development Team（含前端徽章与文档）。
content_en:
1. [Certification Application Form] Added apply-certification.html embedding the Tally application form (zh kblp0R / en LD9gO1), auto-switched by site language; added a '🏅 Apply for Certification' entry in the developer dashboard; AUTHOR_CERTIFICATION.md documents the flow and fields.
2. [EN label alignment] Aligned certification level English names with the Tally form: Premium Producer (was Quality Producer) and Development Team (was Dev Team), in both badges and docs.

content_zh:
1. 【作者认证体系】新增 6 级认证（普通创作者→制作人→优质制作人→开发者→金牌开发者→开发团队）；authors.json 增加 authorlevel（缺省即 1）、official（官方【官方】标识，缺省 false）、studio_special（仅主理团队「本站原创团队」金色特殊徽章）；游戏详情页作者行与作者详情页头部展示徽章；新增 AUTHOR_CERTIFICATION.md。规范：值为 false / level1 的字段可省略以省储存。
2. 【绑定 bug 修复】修复「绑定第三方账号跳登录页并新建账号」：linkIdentity 回跳改回 dashboard.html 并新增 OAuth 回跳处理（exchangeCodeForSession），留在控制台完成绑定；新增「添加/更换邮箱」入口（Supabase 单邮箱主键，仅支持更换）。
3. 【灵动岛】修复向下滚动时灵动岛在边界反复横跳：加入迟滞阈值（进入 80px / 退出 40px），仅状态变化时切换。
4. 【自定义排版】修复排版模式监听泄漏（退出后仍可拖）与「排版模式下点按钮仍触发原动作」：拖动仅排版模式生效、退出时移除监听并拦截点击；拖动放宽为主按钮区双向微调；新增 3 套模版（默认 / 排行榜优先 / 游戏置顶），设置面板一键切换并持久化。
5. 【板块大小】设置面板新增「板块大小」：分别调节导航栏、灵动岛、排行榜、公告、游戏方块，CSS 变量驱动并持久化。
6. 【随机游玩】首页新增「🎲 随机游玩」按钮，随机跳转一款游戏详情页。
7. 【内容】新增 Jeremy 的外网游戏《斜坡大富翁》（Ramp Monopoly，作者 id 8）。
content_en:
1. [Author Certification] Added 6-tier certification (Creator→Producer→Quality Producer→Developer→Gold Developer→Dev Team); authors.json gains authorlevel (default 1), official (【Official】 badge, default false), studio_special (gold 'Official Studio' badge for the main studio only); badges shown on game detail author row and author page; added AUTHOR_CERTIFICATION.md. Convention: false / level-1 fields may be omitted to save space.
2. [Binding fix] Fixed 'linking a provider jumps to login and creates a new account': linkIdentity now redirects back to dashboard.html with a dedicated OAuth-return handler (exchangeCodeForSession); added 'Add/Change email' entry (Supabase single-email primary key, change only).
3. [Dynamic Island] Fixed the island flickering at the scroll boundary by adding hysteresis (enter 80px / exit 40px), toggling only on state change.
4. [Custom Layout] Fixed layout-mode listener leak (draggable after exit) and buttons still firing in layout mode: dragging is active only in layout mode, listeners removed on exit and clicks intercepted; drag range widened to 2-axis; added 3 templates (Default / Ranking-first / Games-first) switchable from settings and persisted.
5. [Section Size] Settings gained a 'Section size' panel to scale top bar, island, ranking, announcements and game cards via CSS variables (persisted).
6. [Random Play] Added a '🎲 Random' button on the homepage that jumps to a random game's detail page.
7. [Content] Added Jeremy's external game 'Ramp Monopoly' (author id 8).

content_zh:
【修复版（在 4.0.0 被 revert 后重做并修复）】
1. 缓存根治：sw.js 升级至 v1.1、预缓存全部页面、激活阶段清理旧缓存并自动刷新一次，消除线上新旧资源混染导致的 CSS 错乱 / 整页大 logo / 设置在但无效。
2. 灵动岛重做：滚动超过 80px 平滑 morph 为 52px 高的单行深色半透明胶囊（max-width 760px、圆角 26px、溢出隐藏），搜索行与分类行平滑收起，回顶恢复完整顶栏；移动端等比收窄；保留三级分级。
3. 搜索增强：新增「全部 / 游戏 / 作者」三范围筛选；作者范围展示真正的作者卡片（头像、名称、作品数，点击进入作者页）；首页 25 条分页（超过才出现）；结果卡片展示作者；相关度排序 + 字段权重（标题 1.0 / 分类 0.75 / 作者 0.6）+ 去重。
4. 设置面板重建：换色同时驱动 --primary 与 --accent（立即可见）；字号经 zoom 立即生效；含自定义背景（按图片信息量自适应淡化 + 每 14 天过期自动恢复默认）与自定义排版（拖拽顶栏按钮上下微调并本地持久化）。
5. 雪期延长至 2027-01-31（specialPeriod 与 yearlyPeriod 两处，跨年逻辑兼容）。
6. reCAPTCHA 容错：安全复验遇 5xx/网络错误时显示友好文案（不再裸显 internal_error 且不再状态行+错误框双重展示），8s 超时 + 1 次重试；服务端错误累计 ≥3 次自动熔断，本轮会话跳过验证（登录/注册仍保持严格）；前端输出结构化诊断。后端 500 真正根因已修复：env.js 的 MODES 缺少 'recaptcha'（issueTicket 用 provider 名作 mode 导致 assertMode 抛错），补入后本地单测与线上真实 token 实测均通过（与密钥无关，Vercel 密钥本就正常）；另保留缺密钥防御性降级 503。
content_en:
[Fix release (re-done after 4.0.0 was reverted)]
1. Cache fix: sw.js bumped to v1.1, precache all pages, purge old cache on activate and auto-refresh once, eliminating the mixed old/new asset rendering that caused broken CSS / full-page logo / non-working settings.
2. Dynamic Island redo: past 80px scroll, smoothly morphs into a 52px-tall single-line dark translucent pill (max-width 760px, 26px radius, overflow hidden); search and category rows collapse smoothly; full bar restored at top; mobile narrows proportionally; 3-tier grading kept.
3. Search upgrade: new All / Games / Authors scope; Authors scope renders real author cards (avatar, name, game count, links to author page); 25-per-page pagination (only when exceeded); results show author; relevance ranking + field weights (title 1.0 / category 0.75 / author 0.6) + dedup.
4. Settings panel rebuilt: accent color drives both --primary and --accent (instantly visible); font size via zoom (instant); custom background (info-density adaptive dimming + 14-day expiry auto-reset) and custom layout (drag top-bar buttons, persisted).
5. Winter activity extended to 2027-01-31 (special + yearly periods; cross-year logic compatible).
6. reCAPTCHA resilience: periodic re-verify shows friendly copy on 5xx/network (no raw internal_error, no double display), 8s timeout + 1 retry; after >=3 consecutive server errors the circuit breaker skips verification for the session (login/register stay strict); structured diagnostics. Backend degrades gracefully to 503 verification_unavailable on missing secrets.

content_zh:
1. 【布局改版】首页升级为双栏布局：游戏列表为主区，排行榜与公告收纳至右侧边栏，不再遮挡下方的游戏内容。
2. 排行榜卡片在侧边栏内自动紧凑化（纵向排列、缩小卡面），并支持侧栏吸顶滚动。
3. 公告板块精简为标题列表：不再直接展示预览内容，点击「查看详情」后在弹窗中阅读完整公告。
4. 新增新布局限时引导：11 月 5 日前首次访问会全屏高亮讲解排行榜与公告的新位置，点击「知道了」完成引导（每人仅一次）。
5. 窄屏（平板/手机）下侧边栏自动回退为单列堆叠，保证移动端阅读体验。
content_en:
1. [Layout Redesign] The homepage now uses a two-column layout: the game list becomes the main area, while the ranking and announcements move to a right sidebar so they no longer block the games below.
2. Ranking cards compact automatically inside the sidebar (vertical stacking, smaller cards) with sticky scrolling.
3. The announcement panel is simplified to a title list: preview content is removed; click "View Details" to read the full announcement in a modal.
4. Added a limited-time onboarding guide: before Nov 5, first visits get a full-screen spotlight walkthrough of the new ranking and announcement positions, dismissed with "Got it" (once per visitor).
5. On narrow screens (tablet/mobile) the sidebar automatically falls back to a single column to preserve the reading experience.

content_zh:
1. 【登录矩阵】开发者登录/注册全面支持第三方一键登录：Google、GitHub、Discord、GitLab、X (Twitter) 五种方式，与邮箱密码并存。
2. 【账号绑定】开发者后台新增「账号绑定」模块：可将多个第三方身份关联到同一账号，任一方式登录均为同一账号与数据，支持一键绑定/解绑（至少保留一种登录方式）。
3. OAuth 登录回调后自动补做人机验证绑定，与邮箱登录的安全体验完全一致。
4. 第三方登录用户进入后台时自动以第三方昵称/头像兜底生成个人资料；无密码账号的「修改密码」流程给出明确指引（通过忘记密码设置）。
5. 第三方登录失败（未开启、白名单未配置、用户取消）时给出中英双语错误提示。
content_en:
1. [Sign-in Matrix] Developer sign-in/sign-up now fully supports one-tap third-party login with Google, GitHub, Discord, GitLab and X (Twitter), alongside email and password.
2. [Account Linking] Added a "Linked Accounts" module in the Dashboard: link multiple third-party identities to the same account — any of them signs into the same account and data, with one-click link/unlink (at least one sign-in method must remain).
3. OAuth callbacks automatically complete the captcha verification binding, matching the security experience of email sign-in.
4. Third-party users get an auto-seeded profile (nickname/avatar) when entering the Dashboard, and passwordless accounts get clear guidance for setting a password via "Forgot password".
5. Bilingual error messages for third-party sign-in failures (provider not enabled, redirect URL not allowlisted, user cancellation).

content_zh:
1. 【合规完善】新增《服务条款》页面（terms.html），中英双语，覆盖账号注册、投稿规范、行为准则、知识产权、第三方服务与免责声明九大章节。
2. 服务条款入口铺设至全站页脚、登录页、游戏守则、关于页、站点文档页、投稿与推荐弹窗，并收录进站点地图（sitemap）。
3. 首页右上角新增「文档」快捷入口，直达站点文档中心（docs.html）。
4. 修复登录页与投稿须知中指向已更名《游戏守则》（game_rules.html）的失效链接。
5. 开发者文档补充第三方一键登录的注册说明。
content_en:
1. [Compliance] Added the bilingual Terms of Service page (terms.html), covering account registration, submission standards, acceptable use, IP, third-party services and disclaimers in nine chapters.
2. Terms of Service links added across the site footer, login page, game rules, about page, docs hub, and the submit/recommend modals, and included in the sitemap.
3. Added a "Docs" shortcut in the homepage top bar linking to the site documentation hub (docs.html).
4. Fixed broken links pointing to the renamed Game Rules page (game_rules.html) on the login page and submission guidelines.
5. Developer docs updated with third-party one-tap sign-up instructions.

content_zh:
1. 新增「推荐游戏」板块：首页可直接打开推荐表单弹窗，无需登录即可提交游戏推荐。
2. 推荐表单支持中英文自动切换，弹窗内嵌表单、独立滚动，移动端自适应。
3. 未登录用户点击「投稿」时会提示两条路径，可直接前往推荐游戏（免登录），也可跳转登录投稿。
4. 新增开发者定向告示系统：通过 noticetodeveloper.json 配置，登录后按作者 ID 精准推送专属公告，支持图片、视频与按钮。
5. 游戏详情页支持视频：横幅与截图区域可放视频直链，或 B站、YouTube、Vimeo 链接自动转换为内嵌播放器。
6. 修复作者主页新上线游戏延迟显示的问题：游戏列表请求增加缓存绕过，上线后立即可见。
7. 全站游戏数据的 author 字段统一为字符串类型，兼容数字 ID 与人名两种写法，避免作者页匹配失败。
content_en:
1. Added the "Recommend a Game" section: the recommendation form can be opened directly from the homepage and submitted without logging in.
2. The recommendation form auto-switches between Chinese and English, embeds in a modal with independent scrolling, and adapts to mobile.
3. When a logged-out user clicks "Submit", two paths are offered: go recommend a game (no login needed) or continue to login.
4. Added the developer-targeted notice system: configured via noticetodeveloper.json, it pushes notices to specific authors by author ID after login, supporting images, videos and buttons.
5. Game detail pages now support video: banners and screenshots accept direct video links, or Bilibili, YouTube and Vimeo links that are automatically converted into embedded players.
6. Fixed the delayed display of newly published games on author pages: game list requests now bypass HTTP cache, so new games appear immediately.
7. Unified the author field across all game data to string type, supporting both numeric IDs and names to avoid author page matching failures.

content_zh:
1. 优化了开发者注册流程，放宽了邮箱验证码的输入长度限制，解决部分用户无法输入完整验证码的问题。
2. 修复了搜索框在输入特定特殊字符时导致的控制台异常报错。
3. 修复了全屏游戏页面被全站活动特效（如冬季雪花）遮挡的底层冲突问题，保障纯净游玩体验。
4. 完善了开发者文档与游戏守则的双语跳转链接，优化了新用户的阅读体验。
content_en:
1. Optimized the developer registration process and relaxed the length limit for the email verification code input, resolving the issue where some users could not enter the full code. 
2. Fixed a console error caused by the search box when entering specific special characters. 
3. Fixed the underlying conflict where full-screen game pages were obstructed by site-wide event effects (like winter snowflakes), ensuring a pure gaming experience. 
4. Improved the bilingual jump links for developer docs and game rules, optimizing the reading experience for new users.

content_zh:
1. 【里程碑】开发者生态系统正式上线！全面接入 Supabase 数据库，支持安全的开发者账号注册、验证码登录与鉴权体系。
2. 全新上线「开发者后台（Dashboard）」，支持一键查看单款游戏的游玩量、收藏量趋势折线图，并附带智能环比 Emoji 数据反馈。
3. 新增「公开作者主页」，玩家点击游戏详情页的开发者名称，即可直达该作者的主页，一览其所有作品及个人简介。
4. 支持开发者在后台上传自定义头像（前端智能压缩至 50KB 以内）及修改个人简介。
5. 引入安全的“双重确认”账号注销机制，并在后台支持一键发送密码重置邮件。
content_en:
1. [Milestone] The developer ecosystem is officially online! Fully integrated with the Supabase database to support secure developer account registration, verification code login, and authentication. 
2. Launched the new 'Developer Dashboard', supporting one-click viewing of play counts, favorites trend line charts, and smart MoM Emoji feedback for individual games. 
3. Added 'Public Author Pages'; players can click the developer's name on the game detail page to go directly to their homepage and see all their works and bio. 
4. Supports developers in uploading custom avatars (with smart front-end compression to under 50KB) and editing their bio in the backend. 
5. Introduced a secure 'double confirmation' account deletion mechanism and supported one-click password reset emails from the backend.

content_zh:
1. 【搜索升级】全新接入智能拼音搜索引擎，支持全拼、首字母、模糊顺序匹配及搜索结果高亮显示。
2. 【布局优化】将搜索框与收藏夹上移至顶部导航栏，同时将热度排行榜前移至公告栏上方，提升首屏信息获取效率。
3. 优化了搜索无结果的空状态提示，并修复了在特定浏览器下搜索框失去焦点的问题。
content_en:
1. [Search Upgrade] Integrated a brand new smart pinyin search engine, supporting full pinyin, initials, fuzzy sequential matching, and search result highlighting. 
2. [Layout Optimization] Moved the search box and favorites to the top navigation bar, and shifted the popularity ranking above the announcements to improve first-screen information efficiency. 
3. Optimized the empty state prompt for no search results and fixed the issue where the search box lost focus in specific browsers.

content_zh:
1. 首页新增“双层筛选导航”，支持在【全部/本站/外网】与【游戏分类】之间进行精准交叉过滤。
2. 新增全站悬浮按钮悬停交互，当鼠标停留在右下角图标时，会浮现具体的功能名称提示（如意见反馈、回到顶部）。
3. 优化了顶部导航栏分类按钮在移动端的横向滑动交互体验。
content_en:
1. Added a 'Double-layer Filter Navigation' to the homepage, supporting precise cross-filtering between [All/Local/External] and [Game Categories]. 
2. Added a hover interaction for floating buttons site-wide; hovering over the bottom-right icons now reveals specific function name tooltips (e.g., Feedback, Back to Top). 
3. Optimized the horizontal swipe interaction experience for filter buttons on mobile devices.

content_zh:
1. 修复了游戏详情页在部分极端网络环境下样式加载错乱的缺陷。
2. 优化了移动端触控事件分发，提升游玩时的操作灵敏度。
3. 修复了深色模式下个别字体对比度不足影响阅读的问题。
4. 修复了首页公告栏在特定交互下的渲染异常。
content_en:
1. Fixed a style loading defect on the game detail page in some extreme network environments. 
2. Optimized mobile touch event distribution to improve operational sensitivity during gameplay. 
3. Fixed the issue of insufficient font contrast in dark mode affecting readability. 
4. Fixed abnormal rendering of the homepage announcement bar under specific interactions.

content_zh:
1. 全新上线首页“全站游戏热度榜”！直观展示全站前 3 名游戏并佩戴金、银、铜牌徽章。
2. 新增“查看更多”弹窗，玩家可一键浏览前 25 名完整榜单。
3. 优化榜单交互，点击卡片可直接跳转至游戏详情页（支持中英双语）。
4. 榜单数据支持加载时实时抓取与每 5 分钟自动刷新，确保热度数据准确。
content_en:
1. Launched the new 'Global Game Ranking' on the homepage! It intuitively displays the top 3 games sitewide with gold, silver, and bronze medals. 
2. Added a 'View More' modal, allowing players to browse the complete top 25 leaderboard with one click. 
3. Optimized leaderboard interactions; clicking a card now redirects directly to the game detail page (supports bilingual). 
4. The leaderboard data supports real-time fetching on load and auto-refresh every 5 minutes, ensuring accurate popularity data.

content_zh:
1. 【游戏上新】休闲品类新游戏《MC 矿工点击器》正式上架！支持直接在线游玩。
2. 【安全加固】针对《MC 矿工点击器》源码进行了深度审查，修复了底层崩溃隐患，并为其作弊码验证引入了 SHA-512 哈希加密算法。
3. 【Bug修复】修复了首页公告栏在用户将公告全部关闭后，连空状态提示框和「查看全部」按钮一起消失的 UI 缺陷。
content_en:
1. [New Game] New casual game 'MC Clicker Game' officially launched! Supports direct online play. 
2. [Security Hardening] Conducted an in-depth code review for 'MC Clicker Game', fixed underlying crash risks, and introduced SHA-512 hash encryption for its cheat code verification. 
3. [Bug Fix] Fixed the UI defect where the announcement bar on the homepage would disappear entirely (including the empty state box and 'View All' button) after users closed all announcements.

content_zh:
1. 【架构升级】全新上线通用活动配置系统（activity_whole.json），实现活动资源、时间锁及配色的独立管理与动态加载。
2. 【冬季限定】正式开启 2026 冬季限定主题！全站飘落浪漫雪花，并自动替换冬日背景、戴帽 Logo、专属 Banner 与角落盲盒贴纸。
3. 【体验优化】新增全站「滑动提示浮窗」，智能引导用户向下滚动查看内容，并在本地化存储 30 天防重复干扰。
4. 【功能接入】正式接入 Tally 中英双语「用户满意度评价与反馈」表单，支持通过右下角悬浮按钮一键唤出。
5. 【Bug修复】彻底修复了游戏详情页（game.html）切换语言时内容不重绘的底层缺陷，实现无缝双语切换。
content_en:
1. [Architectural Upgrade] Launched a new universal activity configuration system (activity_whole.json), enabling independent management and dynamic loading of activity assets, time locks, and color schemes. 
2. [Winter Limited] Officially launched the 2026 Winter Theme! Romantic snowflakes fall site-wide, with automatic replacement of winter backgrounds, logo, exclusive banners, and blind-box stickers in corners. 
3. [UX Optimization] Added a site-wide 'slide hint floating window', intelligently guiding users to scroll down for more content, with a 30-day local storage anti-disturbance mechanism. 
4. [Feature Integration] Officially integrated the Tally bilingual 'User Satisfaction and Feedback' form, accessible via the floating button in the bottom right corner. 
5. [Bug Fix] Thoroughly fixed the underlying defect where content failed to re-render when switching languages on the game detail page (game.html), achieving seamless bilingual switching.

content_zh:
1. 【架构级重构】全站底层升级为 2.0 模块化架构，实现全局语言与底部导航的统一分发。
2. 引入全站全局深色模式，支持系统级偏好自动检测与本地持久化。
3. 重构公告系统底层逻辑：新增未读消息推送提醒、单条公告 24 小时静音机制，并引入类似更新日志的「全部公告」独立浏览弹窗。
4. 新增悬浮实用组件：意见反馈（Tally 接入）、一键回到顶部、PWA 安装提示（1分钟智能触发）。
content_en:
1. [Architectural Refactoring] The site's underlying infrastructure is upgraded to the 2.0 modular architecture, achieving unified distribution of global language and footer navigation. 
2. Introduced global Dark Mode, supporting automatic system preference detection and local persistence. 
3. Refactored the underlying logic of the announcement system: added unread message push reminders, a 24-hour mute mechanism for individual announcements, and introduced a dedicated 'All Announcements' browsing popup similar to the changelog. 
4. Added floating practical components: Feedback (Tally integration), Back to Top, and PWA installation prompt (smart trigger in 1 minute).

content_zh:
1. 针对近期开发者的投稿反馈，深度优化了 Tally 表单的提交流程。
2. 调整代码提交方式为上传 zip/rar 压缩包，并新增「单文件代码直接粘贴」选项，大幅降低上传损坏率。
3. 补充了关于审核邮件通知的温馨提示，引导开发者留意垃圾邮件箱，确保信息触达率。
content_en:
1. Deeply optimized the Tally form submission process based on recent developer feedback. 
2. Changed the code submission method to zip/rar archive upload and added a 'Single File Code Paste' option, significantly reducing upload corruption rates. 
3. Added reminders regarding review email notifications, guiding developers to check their spam folders to ensure information delivery.

content_zh:
1. 全新上线独立的「更新日志」模块，支持按版本维度精准追溯平台历史迭代。
2. 深度集成 Edgemetry 无埋点统计系统，实现全站 PV/UV 及游戏点击转化率的精准追踪。
3. 全面优化底层资源加载策略，显著提升全平台页面的首屏渲染速度与响应能力。
content_en:
1. Launched an independent 'Changelog' module, supporting accurate tracking of platform historical iterations by version. 
2. Deeply integrated the Edgemetry analytics system to achieve precise tracking of site-wide PV/UV and game click conversion rates. 
3. Comprehensively optimized the underlying resource loading strategy, significantly improving the first-screen rendering speed and responsiveness across all platform pages.

content_zh:
1. 重构游戏卡片网格布局算法，完美适配多端响应式显示，消除边界溢出问题。
2. 优化中英双语切换的底层逻辑，彻底解决切换时的页面闪烁与重绘性能损耗。
3. 调整并统一了全站组件的 UI 视觉规范，提升了界面整体的沉浸感与一致性。
content_en:
1. Refactored the game card grid layout algorithm for perfect multi-device responsive display, eliminating boundary overflow issues. 
2. Optimized the underlying logic of bilingual switching, completely resolving page flickering and repaint performance losses during switching. 
3. Adjusted and unified the UI visual specifications of site-wide components, enhancing the immersion and consistency of the interface.

content_zh:
1. 正式上线「关于我们」独立页面，全方位展示平台愿景与开发者权益承诺。
2. 完善平台合规体系，引入《隐私政策》与《版权侵权投诉指引》等底层保障入口。
3. 优化导航栏层级结构与路由分发，大幅提升用户获取平台信息的便捷度。
content_en:
1. Officially launched the 'About Us' page, comprehensively showcasing the platform's vision and commitments to developer rights. 
2. Improved the platform's compliance system by introducing underlying protection entrances such as the 'Privacy Policy' and 'Copyright Infringement Guidelines'. 
3. Optimized the navigation bar hierarchy and route distribution, greatly enhancing user convenience in accessing platform information.

content_zh:
1. 「了了了游」全新架构正式上线！完成了全站底层技术的彻底重构，剥离了历史技术债。
2. 原生支持中英双语无缝切换，全面拓展了平台服务于全球化用户的能力。
3. 引入本地化游戏收藏与全局检索功能，大幅优化玩家寻找心仪游戏的心智负担。
content_en:
1. The brand new architecture of 'lelele Game' officially launched! Completed a thorough refactoring of the entire site's underlying technology, eliminating historical technical debt. 
2. Native support for seamless bilingual (Chinese/English) switching, comprehensively expanding the platform's ability to serve global users. 
3. Introduced local game favorites and global search functions, greatly optimizing the mental burden on players finding their desired games.

content_zh:
1. 上线前执行了全链路黑盒测试，修复了若干影响体验的边界缺陷。
2. 优化了资源请求机制，降低了网络延迟导致的加载失败率。
3. 完善了全局异常捕获机制，提升了系统整体的鲁棒性。
content_en:
1. Executed full-link black-box testing prior to launch, fixing several boundary defects affecting the experience. 
2. Optimized the resource request mechanism, reducing the loading failure rate caused by network latency. 
3. Improved the global exception capture mechanism, enhancing the overall robustness of the system.

content_zh:
1. 监测到旧版底层源代码存在严重的耦合崩坏，启动紧急技术预案。
2. 将旧版历史遗留代码全部删除，从零开始搭建全新纯净架构。
3. 重建了数据分发链路，确保后续版本迭代的稳定性与可维护性。
content_en:
1. Detected severe coupling corruption in the legacy underlying source code and activated an emergency technical plan. 
2. Deleted all legacy code from the old version and built a brand new pure architecture from scratch. 
3. Rebuilt the data distribution pipeline to ensure the stability and maintainability of future version iterations.

content_zh:
1. 了了了游正式启动复出计划，完成服务器及静态资源的重新部署。
2. 梳理并优化了游戏上架的审核流转链路。
3. 展开内部封闭测试，收集核心玩家反馈以打磨最终体验。
content_en:
1. lelele Game officially launched its comeback plan, completing the redeployment of servers and static resources. 
2. Organized and optimized the review workflow for game listings.

content_zh:

content_zh:

content_zh:

content_en:
